name: Sliced Bean Salad
description: A tangy and sweet pickled bean salad made with green or yellow beans, perfect for serving with onion and cream.

recipeInstructions.text: Slice the beans and cook until tender enough to pierce with a fork.
Drain the cooked beans and pack them into jars.
In a saucepan, bring the sugar, water, vinegar, and salt to a boil to make the syrup.
Pour the hot syrup over the beans in the jars.
To serve, pour off the liquid and add chopped onion and cream.

keywords: pickled bean salad, sweet and tangy, preserved beans

_similar.name: Sauerkraut Salad
_similar.description: A tangy and crunchy salad featuring sauerkraut, chopped vegetables, and a sweet-and-sour dressing that keeps well in the refrigerator.
recipeIngredient: 1 (28 oz) jar or can sauerkraut, drained

recipeInstructions.text: Heat the vinegar, sugar, and salt in a saucepan until boiling.
Let the dressing cool to room temperature.
In a large bowl, combine the drained sauerkraut, chopped celery, onion, red pepper, and green pepper.
Pour the cooled dressing over the salad and toss to coat.
Store in a sealed container in the refrigerator for up to 2-3 weeks.

_similar.keywords: sauerkraut salad, tangy salad, make-ahead salad

_similar.name: Onion Salad
_similar.description: A simple onion salad marinated in a sweet and tangy dressing.

recipeInstructions.text: Marinate the thinly sliced onions with salt, sugar, water, and vinegar overnight.
Drain the marinade well in the morning.
Add mayonnaise (or salad dressing) and celery seed to the drained onions.
Chill until ready to serve.

_similar.keywords: onion salad, marinated onions, sweet and tangy salad

_similar.name: Salad Dressing
_similar.description: A thickened salad dressing made by boiling a mixture of eggs, sugar, flour, mustard, water, and vinegar, finished with butter.

recipeInstructions.text: Beat eggs and add sugar and dry ingredients.
Boil water and vinegar together.
Pour egg mixture into vinegar-water mixture and boil until it thickens, stirring continually.
Take off heat and stir in 1 Tbsp butter.

_similar.name: Broccoli Supreme
_similar.description: A chilled broccoli salad with raisins, bacon, and a creamy cheese dressing.
recipeIngredient: 6 or 8 slices bacon, cooled and crumbled

recipeInstructions.text: Beat dressing ingredients until smooth.
Add dressing to broccoli, raisins, and onion. Cover and chill at least 3 hours.
Sprinkle with bacon and serve.

_similar.name: Pickled Eggs
_similar.description: Tangy pickled eggs made with vinegar, mustard, and spices, perfect for snacking or as a side dish.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine the vinegar, water, mustard, salt, pepper, and onion pieces in a saucepan.
Bring the mixture to a boil.
Pour the hot pickling liquid over the hard-boiled eggs.
Let the eggs stand in the pickling liquid for 5 days before serving.

_similar.keywords: pickled eggs, tangy snack, preserved eggs
